rows.text: This was expected but one more bit of Fire roster housekeeping for now: Nika Mühl has officially been designated as "out for the season with a non-WNBA injury" meaning her contract will be suspended and not count against the cap.
rows.name: Nika Mühl

rows.text: Does not include Nika Mühl (out for the season and will have contract suspended) or first-round pick Iyana Martín, who is staying in Spain this year.
rows.name: Nika Mühl
